abstract: Addendum: ACMG Practice Guideline: lack of evidence for MTHFR polymorphism testing Michael T. Curry, MD and Helga V. Toriello, PhD for the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG) Professional Practice and Guidelines Committee Genetics in Medicine (2020) 22:2125; https://doi.org/10.1038/s41436-020-0843-0 Addendum to: Genetics in Medicine 15:153–156 (2013); https://doi.org/10.1038/gim.2012.165, published online 3 October 2013. This document was reaffirmed by the ACMG Board of Directors as of 27 April 2020 with the following addendum: Since this document no longer meets the criteria for an evidence-based practice guideline by the College, it has been reclassified as a Clinical Practice Resource.
